Problem Statement:
Write a program to check if a given class name follows Java naming conventions. 
Input Description:
A single string representing a class name. 
Output Description:
"Valid Naming" or "Invalid Naming". 
Sample Input:
MyClass 
Sample Output:
Valid Naming 
Explanation:
Class names should start with an uppercase letter.
Print "Valid Naming" if correct, else "Invalid Naming".
